title: The Fighting Cricket
synopsis: A tale of the hardships facing a man trying to find a fierce cricket for the emperor!

fullText.simplified:
成名和妻子已经不知道生气了。他们呆呆地坐在地上，你看看我，我看看你，说不出话来。到家后，做好的菜还在桌子上，他们看都没看一眼。
    他们把东东带回家，觉得他身子还是热的，还有气，就先把他放在了床上。到了晚上，东东坐起来，看了看成名，呆呆的，不笑，不说话，好像不认识他的样子。过了一会儿，东东躺了下来，好像又睡过去了。
    蛐蛐死了，儿子又成了这样，成名呆坐在床边，吃不下饭，睡不着觉。
    第二天早上，成名突然听到门外有蛐蛐的叫声。他跳起来，看向门外。真的是一只蛐蛐！成名心里高兴，赶紧跑去捉它！蛐蛐叫了一声，跳走了。成名又跑去追，蛐蛐跳得很快，成名紧跟在后面。一转眼，蛐蛐不见了。成名东看看西看看，忙着找蛐蛐。终于，在一块小石头上，看到了蛐蛐。这只蛐蛐小小的，黑红黑红的。成名觉得它太小了，捉了也没用，转身想走，只见这只蛐蛐自己跳到了成名的手上。
    成名看了看它，觉得它虽然小，但是样子很好。“有蛐蛐比没蛐蛐好”，这么一想，成名把蛐蛐带回了家。他想送这只蛐蛐去给市长，但又怕市长看不上，就想先试试，看这只蛐蛐厉不厉害。
fullText.traditional:
成名和妻子已經不知道生氣了。他們呆呆地坐在地上，你看看我，我看看你，說不出話來。到家後，做好的菜還在桌子上，他們看都沒看一眼。
    他們把東東帶回家，覺得他身子還是熱的，還有氣，就先把他放在了床上。到了晚上，東東坐起來，看了看成名，呆呆的，不笑，不說話，好像不認識他的樣子。過了一會兒，東東躺了下來，好像又睡過去了。
    蛐蛐死了，兒子又成了這樣，成名呆坐在床邊，吃不下飯，睡不著覺。
    第二天早上，成名突然聽到門外有蛐蛐的叫聲。他跳起來，看向門外。真的是一隻蛐蛐！成名心裡高興，趕緊跑去捉它！蛐蛐叫了一聲，跳走了。成名又跑去追，蛐蛐跳得很快，成名緊跟在後面。一轉眼，蛐蛐不見了。成名東看看西看看，忙著找蛐蛐。終於，在一塊小石頭上，看到了蛐蛐。這隻蛐蛐小小的，黑紅黑紅的。成名覺得它太小了，捉了也沒用，轉身想走，只見這隻蛐蛐自己跳到了成名的手上。
    成名看了看它，覺得它雖然小，但是樣子很好。“有蛐蛐比沒蛐蛐好”，這麼一想，成名把蛐蛐帶回了家。他想送這隻蛐蛐去給市長，但又怕市長看不上，就想先試試，看這隻蛐蛐厲不厲害。

sentences.simplified: 成名和妻子已经不知道生气了。
sentences.traditional: 成名和妻子已經不知道生氣了。
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng hé qī zi yǐ jīng bù zhī dào shēng qì le
sentences.english: Cheng Ming and his wife had already forgotten about their anger.

sentences.simplified: 他们呆呆地坐在地上，你看看我，我看看你，说不出话来。
sentences.traditional: 他們呆呆地坐在地上，你看看我，我看看你，說不出話來。
sentences.pinyin: tā men dāi dāi de zuò zài dì shang nǐ kàn kan wǒ wǒ kàn kan nǐ shuō bu chū huà lái
sentences.english: They blankly sat on the ground and looked at each other, not uttering a word.

sentences.simplified: 到家后，做好的菜还在桌子上，他们看都没看一眼。
sentences.traditional: 到家後，做好的菜還在桌子上，他們看都沒看一眼。
sentences.pinyin: dào jiā hòu zuò hǎo de cài hái zài zhuō zi shang tā men kàn dōu méi kàn yì yǎn
sentences.english: When they returned home, the food was still ready on the table. They didn’t even give it a glance.

sentences.simplified: 他们把东东带回家，
sentences.traditional: 他們把東東帶回家，
sentences.pinyin: tā men bǎ dōng dōng dài huí jiā
sentences.english: They brought Dongdong back home.

sentences.simplified: 觉得他身子还是热的，还有气，就先把他放在了床上。
sentences.traditional: 覺得他身子還是熱的，還有氣，就先把他放在了床上。
sentences.pinyin: jué de tā shēn zi hái shì rè de hái yǒu qì jiù xiān bǎ tā fàng zài le chuáng shang
sentences.english: They felt that his body was still warm, and he was still breathing, so they put him to bed.

sentences.simplified: 到了晚上，东东坐起来，看了看成名，呆呆的，
sentences.traditional: 到了晚上，東東坐起來，看了看成名，呆呆的，
sentences.pinyin: dào le wǎn shang dōng dōng zuò qi lai kàn le kàn chéng míng dāi dāi de
sentences.english: In the evening, Dongdong sat up and looked blankly at Cheng Ming, ..

sentences.simplified: 不笑，不说话，好像不认识他的样子。
sentences.traditional: 不笑，不說話，好像不認識他的樣子。
sentences.pinyin: bú xiào bù shuō huà hǎo xiàng bú rèn shi tā de yàng zi
sentences.english: .. without smiling or saying anything. It was like he didn’t recognize him.

sentences.simplified: 过了一会儿，东东躺了下来，好像又睡过去了。
sentences.traditional: 過了一會兒，東東躺了下來，好像又睡過去了。
sentences.pinyin: guò le yí huì'r dōng dōng tǎng le xia lai hǎo xiàng yòu shuì guò qu le
sentences.english: After a while, Dongdong lay down. It looked like he’d fallen asleep again.

sentences.simplified: 蛐蛐死了，儿子又成了这样，
sentences.traditional: 蛐蛐死了，兒子又成了這樣，
sentences.pinyin: qū qū sǐ le ér zi yòu chéng le zhè yàng
sentences.english: The cricket is dead, and my son has gotten like this.

sentences.simplified: 成名呆坐在床边，吃不下饭，睡不着觉。
sentences.traditional: 成名呆坐在床邊，吃不下飯，睡不著覺。
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng dāi zuò zài chuáng biān chī bú xià fàn shuì bù zháo jiào
sentences.english: Cheng Ming blankly sat by the bed. He was unable to eat or sleep.

sentences.simplified: 第二天早上，成名突然听到门外有蛐蛐的叫声。
sentences.traditional: 第二天早上，成名突然聽到門外有蛐蛐的叫聲。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr tiān zǎo shang chéng míng tū rán tīng dào mén wài yǒu qū qū de jiào shēng
sentences.english: The next morning, Cheng Ming suddenly heard the chirping of a cricket outside the door.

sentences.simplified: 他跳起来，看向门外。真的是一只蛐蛐！
sentences.traditional: 他跳起來，看向門外。真的是一隻蛐蛐！
sentences.pinyin: tā tiào qi lai kàn xiàng mén wài zhēn de shì yì zhī qū qū
sentences.english: He jumped up, and looked outside the door. It really was a cricket!

sentences.simplified: 成名心里高兴，赶紧跑去捉它！蛐蛐叫了一声，跳走了。
sentences.traditional: 成名心裡高興，趕緊跑去捉它！蛐蛐叫了一聲，跳走了。
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng xīn li gāo xìng gǎn jǐn pǎo qù zhuō tā qū qū jiào le yì shēng tiào zǒu le
sentences.english: Cheng Ming was very happy, and hurriedly ran to catch it! The cricket chirped, and jumped away.

sentences.simplified: 成名又跑去追，蛐蛐跳得很快，成名紧跟在后面。
sentences.traditional: 成名又跑去追，蛐蛐跳得很快，成名緊跟在後面。
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng yòu pǎo qù zhuī qū qū tiào de hěn kuài chéng míng jǐn gēn zài hòu miàn
sentences.english: Cheng Ming kept running after it. The cricket jumped very fast, and Cheng Ming followed right behind it.

sentences.simplified: 一转眼，蛐蛐不见了。成名东看看西看看，忙着找蛐蛐。
sentences.traditional: 一轉眼，蛐蛐不見了。成名東看看西看看，忙著找蛐蛐。
sentences.pinyin: yì zhuǎn yǎn qū qū bú jiàn le chéng míng dōng kàn kan xī kàn kan máng zhe zhǎo qū qū
sentences.english: In the blink of an eye, the cricket vanished. Cheng Ming looked all around, busily searching for the cricket.

sentences.simplified: 终于，在一块小石头上，看到了蛐蛐。这只蛐蛐小小的，黑红黑红的。
sentences.traditional: 終於，在一塊小石頭上，看到了蛐蛐。這隻蛐蛐小小的，黑紅黑紅的。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng yú zài yí kuài xiǎo shí tou shang kàn dào le qū qū zhè zhī qū qū xiǎo xiǎo de hēi hóng hēi hóng de
sentences.english: Finally, he saw the cricket on a small rock. This was a very small, black and red cricket.

sentences.simplified: 成名觉得它太小了，捉了也没用，
sentences.traditional: 成名覺得它太小了，捉了也沒用，
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng jué de tā tài xiǎo le zhuō le yě méi yòng
sentences.english: Cheng Ming thought that it was too small, it wouldn’t be any use catching it.

sentences.simplified: 转身想走，只见这只蛐蛐自己跳到了成名的手上。
sentences.traditional: 轉身想走，只見這隻蛐蛐自己跳到了成名的手上。
sentences.pinyin: zhuǎn shēn xiǎng zǒu zhǐ jiàn zhè zhī qū qū zì jǐ tiào dào le chéng míng de shǒu shang
sentences.english: Cheng Ming turned around to leave, only to see the cricket jumping into his hand by itself.

sentences.simplified: 成名看了看它，觉得它虽然小，但是样子很好。
sentences.traditional: 成名看了看它，覺得它雖然小，但是樣子很好。
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng kàn le kàn tā jué de tā suī rán xiǎo dàn shì yàng zi hěn hǎo
sentences.english: Cheng Ming looked at it, thinking that although it was small, it had a good appearance.

sentences.simplified: “有蛐蛐比没蛐蛐好”，这么一想，成名把蛐蛐带回了家。
sentences.traditional: “有蛐蛐比沒蛐蛐好”，這麼一想，成名把蛐蛐帶回了家。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu qū qū bǐ méi qū qū hǎo zhè me yì xiǎng chéng míng bǎ qū qū dài huí le jiā
sentences.english: “Having a cricket is better than not having a cricket.” With that in mind, Cheng Ming brought the cricket back home.

sentences.simplified: 他想送这只蛐蛐去给市长，但又怕市长看不上，
sentences.traditional: 他想送這隻蛐蛐去給市長，但又怕市長看不上，
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng sòng zhè zhī qū qū qù gěi shì zhǎng dàn yòu pà shì zhǎng kàn bu shàng
sentences.english: He wanted to give this cricket to the mayor, but was also afraid that the mayor would have a low opinion of it.

sentences.simplified: 就想先试试，看这只蛐蛐厉不厉害。
sentences.traditional: 就想先試試，看這隻蛐蛐厲不厲害。
sentences.pinyin: jiù xiǎng xiān shì shi kàn zhè zhī qū qū lì bú lì hai
sentences.english: So he wanted to test it first, to see if the cricket was fierce or not.

raw.synopsis: A tale of the hardships facing a man trying to find a fierce cricket for the emperor!
sentence_translations: Cheng Ming and his wife had already forgotten about their anger.
They blankly sat on the ground and looked at each other, not uttering a word.
When they returned home, the food was still ready on the table. They didn’t even give it a glance.
They brought Dongdong back home.
They felt that his body was still warm, and he was still breathing, so they put him to bed.
In the evening, Dongdong sat up and looked blankly at Cheng Ming, ..
.. without smiling or saying anything. It was like he didn’t recognize him.
After a while, Dongdong lay down. It looked like he’d fallen asleep again.
The cricket is dead, and my son has gotten like this.
Cheng Ming blankly sat by the bed. He was unable to eat or sleep.
The next morning, Cheng Ming suddenly heard the chirping of a cricket outside the door.
He jumped up, and looked outside the door. It really was a cricket!
Cheng Ming was very happy, and hurriedly ran to catch it! The cricket chirped, and jumped away.
Cheng Ming kept running after it. The cricket jumped very fast, and Cheng Ming followed right behind it.
In the blink of an eye, the cricket vanished. Cheng Ming looked all around, busily searching for the cricket.
Finally, he saw the cricket on a small rock. This was a very small, black and red cricket.
Cheng Ming thought that it was too small, it wouldn’t be any use catching it.
Cheng Ming turned around to leave, only to see the cricket jumping into his hand by itself.
Cheng Ming looked at it, thinking that although it was small, it had a good appearance.
“Having a cricket is better than not having a cricket.” With that in mind, Cheng Ming brought the cricket back home.
He wanted to give this cricket to the mayor, but was also afraid that the mayor would have a low opinion of it.
So he wanted to test it first, to see if the cricket was fierce or not.
